name: katari-consorcio-monorepo
description: Katari Consórcios - Fullstack Monorepo (Server Express + Frontend Nuxt)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server-consorcio" "npm run dev --prefix zuvio-web"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server-consorcio && npm install --prefix zuvio-web
